en: Sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated basilica with Byzantine-style arches, columns, and ornate capitals. A prominent stone column stands in the foreground. In the background there is an altar or sanctuary area with patterned walls and arches. The layout and caption indicate this is the Basilica of Saint Sophia in Salonique (Thessaloniki). The front includes printed text in French and a photographer credit.
